articles.deck: Every franchise graded, no feelings spared. Four seasons, four champions, zero dynasties.

articles.title: Draft Preview 2026

articles.title: Draft Eve 2026: The Desk Files Its Predictions
articles.deck: The order held, the board survived the cuts, and ten managers are about to do exactly what four years of tape says they will.

articles.title: The Draft Desk: The Full Broadcast
articles.deck: Every call and every homer overreach, exactly as it aired — the complete two-voice transcript of the 2026 draft, pick one through one hundred fifty.

articles.title: The Desk Grades the Draft
articles.deck: Ten rosters, one kicker emergency, and a Cowboys outbreak. The desk has reviewed the tape.

articles.title: Kickoff Week: The Desk Sets the Lines
articles.deck: Five games, ten rosters that looked perfect on Sunday, and one franchise that has never won an opener. The desk has consulted four years of tape and is prepared to be wrong in public.

articles.title: The Paper Was Right: D1LLIGAF Wins a September
articles.deck: Four years, zero opening-week wins, one running gag, retired on the spot by a 152.46. Also: a 183-point statement, a points queen who benched 56 points, and a desk that went 2-3 on its own picks.

articles.title: The Late Edition: Five Games, One Already Started
articles.deck: The desk intended to file Wednesday night, after waivers. The desk did not. Buffalo and Detroit are already on the board, Josh Allen has 34.08 of them, and we are previewing the week anyway.

articles.title: Everybody Fixed Last Week's Lineup: The Bench Did Not Get the Memo
articles.deck: Two managers corrected Week 1's mistakes to the letter and got punished for it, a backup quarterback decided a game from the bench on Monday night, and three of five results would have flipped with a better lineup. The desk went 4-1.

articles.title: The Late Edition, Again: Four Unbeatens, Nowhere to Hide
articles.deck: Four teams are 2–0 and none of them plays another. Two draw winless teams, one draws Dawnieo, divinethought draws the champion, and the desk is filing on Thursday night for the second week running.

articles.title: The Chair Finally Chose Correctly: It Chose Against Us
articles.deck: jgirsby started the right quarterback for the first time this season and handed the desk's own franchise, which had a perfect lineup, its first loss. A game was decided by 0.58 with 42.90 on the loser's bench, the champion's two backup quarterbacks both outscored her starter, and the desk went 2-3.

articles.title: Filed on Wednesday: Two Lineups Fixed, One Did Not Move
articles.deck: The champion now starts the quarterback who scored 31.80 on her bench. BrennaLynne now starts the receiver who scored 21.00 on hers. divinethought, beaten by 0.58 with 42.90 on the bench, has not changed a single starter. And one team has no defense at all.

articles.title: Eight-Tenths of a Point: The Carousel Stopped on the Wrong Quarterback
articles.deck: The desk's own franchise won by 0.80 on Monday night while the opposing bench held a 32.16-point quarterback. The receiver this desk spent two weeks questioning scored 45.20. sammyyy29 posted the third-best score of the week and lost by less than one tight end. And the desk went 5-0.

articles.title: Five Starters on a Bye: The Unbeaten Team Owns Three of Them
articles.deck: Kansas City and Carolina are off this week, and at press time five of their players are still in starting lineups. Three belong to the only 4-0 team in the league. A tight end decision finally changed, a quarterback decision did not, and the desk picks against itself.

articles.title: The Carousel Moved: It Picked the Wrong Quarterback Again
articles.deck: For three straight weeks Dawnieo started Trevor Lawrence and benched Drake Maye. In Week 6 she started Maye. Lawrence scored 35.34 on the bench, and the best possible lineup would have won by 0.06. Also: the desk's analytics department won its argument and lost its game, BrennaLynne posted the week's high score, and the desk owes the league an issue.

articles.title: Seven Starters on a Bye: The Desk Fixed Its Own and Is Telling Everyone
articles.deck: Buffalo, Jacksonville, the Chargers and Washington are off, and at press time seven of their players are still in starting lineups, including the league leader's quarterback. The desk's own was fixed before filing. Dawnieo's quarterback decision has been made for her, and with every lineup fixed, the desk's game is a 0.6-point coin flip.

articles.title: Analytics Started the Wrong Receivers: Both of Them
articles.deck: The desk's own franchise started Chris Godwin and Germie Bernard, who scored 12.40 between them. KC Concepcion and Omar Cooper scored 45.70 on the bench, and the best possible lineup beats divinethought by 3.96. Also: mmcatee01 posted the week's high, Jordan Love finally started, and the preview went 3–2.
